name: Rondain SEO
author: gabrielmichael

sections.description:
Rondain SEO checks your posts the way Google reads them and helps you fix what it finds. Everything runs on your own site and needs no account. Checks only read; the plugin changes something only when you click to do so.

SEO analysis

  • A Rondain score (0-100) for every post and page, with plain advice for each point: SEO title and meta description length, focus keyphrase in the title, description, first paragraph, address and a subheading, keyphrase overuse, enough useful words, subheadings, a single main heading, image alt text, featured image, internal and outbound links, and whether the post is hidden from Google.
  • “Analyse all published posts” checks the whole site in small batches and shows the posts that need the most work first.
  • Works with or without another SEO plugin. With Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework or Slim SEO active, Rondain SEO reads their SEO title and description (and the focus keyphrase from Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress) for the checks and never prints a second set of tags.

SEO fields and tags (when no other SEO plugin is active)

  • SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase, canonical URL and noindex in a box below the editor, with a search result preview and character counters.
  • Prints the meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, and structured data (Organization, WebSite, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList).

Image alt text

  • Lists images in the Media Library without alt text and suggests one from the image title or file name. You edit and tick the ones you want, review them on a confirmation screen, then apply.

Broken links

  • Collects the links in your published content and checks each address. Broken links can be removed after review; the link text stays in place.

404 log and redirects

  • Logs addresses that visitors or Google opened but that do not exist, with limits so bots cannot fill your database.
  • Add a 301 or 302 redirect to a page on your site in one click. Redirects only run while the old address is missing, so an existing page is never redirected.

Security check (read-only)

  • Compares WordPress core files with the official checksums, looks for PHP files in the uploads folder, and reviews search engine visibility, HTTPS, error display, the file editor, security keys, the “admin” username, administrator accounts, PHP version and waiting updates. It reports and links to the right WordPress screen; it changes nothing.

Speed clean-ups (off until you switch them on)

  • Remove the emoji script, the embed script, Dashicons for visitors, and the WordPress version tag.

You stay in control

  • The plugin has no REST endpoints and accepts no instructions from outside your site. No outside service can change anything on your site through this plugin.
  • Every action is started by a logged-in administrator in wp-admin and protected by a capability check and a nonce. Changes to your content (alt text, removed links) are listed on a confirmation screen first and stored in Change history with their old value, so they can be restored with one click. Redirects and settings change only when you save them, and can be deleted or changed back on the same screen.
  • The plugin never installs or updates plugins, themes or WordPress. Updates stay with the normal WordPress Updates screen.
  • Nothing is locked: every feature in the plugin is free to use.

The plugin is made by Rondain (rondain.com), a website monitoring service for site owners in Indonesia. The plugin does not connect to the Rondain service. Its Overview screen describes the optional paid Rondain service (Repair SEO, site care, malware clean-up, security and backups) with links to rondain.com; nothing in this plugin depends on it.

External services

The plugin does not send any data about your site or your visitors to Rondain or to any other company. It only makes the requests below, and only when an administrator clicks the button that starts them.

WordPress.org (security check)

When you click “Run check” on the Security check screen, WordPress downloads the official checksums of your WordPress version from api.wordpress.org (the same request the WP-CLI “core verify-checksums” command makes). Only your WordPress version and locale are sent. WordPress.org privacy policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

The update information shown in the security check comes from the update check WordPress already does by itself; the plugin makes no extra request for it.

Sites you link to (broken link scan)

When you click “Scan links” on the Broken links screen, the plugin requests each address that your published posts link to (a HEAD request, or a short GET request when a site refuses HEAD), to see whether the page still exists. The request contains the address itself and a user agent naming this plugin and your site address, as any visitor’s browser would. Each linked site’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Rondain SEO”, then click Install and Activate. Or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Open Rondain SEO in the admin menu and click “Analyse all published posts”.
  3. Open a post to see its checks in the Rondain SEO box below the editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Rondain account?

No. The plugin works on its own and does not connect to the Rondain service.

Can anyone change my site through this plugin?

No. The plugin registers no REST API routes and no public endpoints. Its actions only run for a logged-in administrator in wp-admin, after a nonce check and a confirmation screen.

Will it conflict with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. When another SEO plugin is active, Rondain SEO does not print any SEO tags and does not write to that plugin’s fields. It only reads them for the analysis.

How do I undo a change?

Open Rondain SEO > Change history and click Restore next to the change. If the post or image was edited after the change, you are asked before the newer edit is overwritten.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

Its settings, scores, scan results, 404 log, redirects and change history. SEO titles, descriptions and keyphrases you typed in the editor are kept, because they are your content.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Overview: the optional Rondain service box now explains what the paid service adds, with links to rondain.com. Nothing in the plugin is locked.
  • Code: database queries use the table name with the site prefix directly.

1.0.0

  • First release on WordPress.org: SEO analysis, editor fields, image alt text, broken links, 404 log and redirects, read-only security check, speed clean-ups and change history. No remote endpoints; all changes happen only on an administrator’s click.

short_description: SEO checks for every post, meta fields, image alt text, broken links, 404 redirects and a read-only security check. Changes only when you click.
